errors.text: The proposed oxygen/nitrogen interstitial intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr to HfMoTaTiZr.
Neither cited study provides evidence for oxygen- or nitrogen-induced ordered interstitial complexes or for preserving room-temperature ductility through this mechanism.
The hypothesis does not specify an alloy composition, interstitial concentration, or quantitative acceptable density and room-temperature-performance limits.
The experiment lacks explicit room-temperature testing despite making preservation of room-temperature performance part of its falsification rule.
